questions: Did the group explicitly discuss converting gold pieces into experience points as a game rule?
Was there discussion of how much experience points were needed to reach the next character level?
Did the players roll a six-sided die to determine which side was surprised at the start of combat?
Did the players roll dice to determine initiative order for combat turns?
Was the mechanical process of rolling a d20 plus modifiers to hit an armor class explained?
Was there discussion of adding a strength modifier to melee attack rolls?
Did someone explain that a backstab ability grants a bonus to attack rolls and extra damage dice?
Was there discussion of the base damage die for a specific weapon like a sling or spear?
Did the group debate whether saving throws are rolled under or over a target number?
Was there discussion of passive versus active bonuses for searching for secret doors?
Was there out-of-character talk about a real-world baseball game and players?
Did the group discuss converting the value of found treasure into experience points once sold?
Did participants discuss looking up character sheet rules or stats mid-session?
Did Sir Phidipaldi recieve a +1 bonus to all rolls for the rest of the adventure?
